info.name: Employee Portal
info.summary: A wiki-style intranet built on your Nextcloud files
info.description:
Employee Portal turns a folder of markdown files into a browsable intranet.
Pages are plain `.md` files stored in the **EmployeePortal** folder of your Nextcloud. Access is entirely governed by Nextcloud's own file permissions — the app adds no permission model of its own, so sharing a page is the same as sharing its file.
info.author: Lukas Lutz
